description: Replace GenOffice's BYOK multi-provider AI layer (@genoffice/ai-provider) with the Redrob engine as an additional/secondary AI feature layered onto the ported editors, honoring the Redrob invariants. GenOffice's apps each import @genoffice/ai-provider (Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/OpenAI/custom, provider-selection UI). Redrob policy allows ONE engine (Redrob Console, no BYOK, no third-party provider names/selection UI, honest-failure steering, fixed route). Bridge the apps' AI panels to the existing Redrob engine in office/src/main (redrob-code/*, services/chat.ts, tools/*) so document AI edits run on Redrob. Keep the editors' AI as a document-scoped assistant (reuse the prior branch's office-shell/ai/* seam as reference).
steps: Create a Redrob-backed replacement for the @genoffice/ai-provider public interface: a workspace shim (e.g. packages/ai-provider re-exported as @genoffice/ai-provider) whose exported chat/stream/registry API keeps the same TypeScript surface the apps import, but routes to the single Redrob Console engine (fixed base https://console.redrob.ai/api/backend/v1, model redrob-ai / redrob/auto) via the existing office/src/main/redrob-code + services/chat transport. No provider-selection, no configurable base URL, no third-party provider names in code or UI.

Remove/neutralize provider-selection UI and BYOK settings in the ported apps' renderers (each app's ai/* and settings) and the shell SettingsModal/provider-logos: replace with the single Redrob route. Strip Genspark/GSK env-key branding (GSK_API_KEY, provider logos) from the AI paths. Preserve honest-failure behavior: on engine unavailability show the Redrob-branded install/connect notice (mirror office/src/main/redrob-code/steering.ts redrobCodeUnavailableMessage); never claim a silent third-party fallback.

Wire the document-scoped AI assistant: connect each editor app's AI edit protocol (docs ai/tools.ts, ai/protocol.ts, edit-queue; and the equivalents in sheets/slides/pdf/markdown) to the Redrob engine so 'AI as a secondary, document-scoped editor assistant' works. Reference the prior branch's office-shell/ai/assistant-edit-bridge and editor-edit-seam for the seam shape, but drive the ported GenOffice editors (not the rejected minimal ones).
Ensure no em dashes in any new/changed user-facing copy; keep i18n en/ko key parity for any strings touched; route shared controls through packages/ui shadcn where new UI is added.

Add/port tests locking the invariants: the ai-provider shim rejects any provider-selection/BYOK surface and only targets the Redrob route; honest-failure steering has no third-party name and no silent degraded mode (mirror redrob-code/steering.test.ts). Run the ported apps' AI-related tests plus these new contract tests.
Typecheck and build all apps + shell with the Redrob AI layer in place; run `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` at root.
acceptance_criteria: The @genoffice/ai-provider import surface resolves to a Redrob-backed implementation targeting only https://console.redrob.ai/api/backend/v1 with model redrob-ai/redrob/auto; no BYOK/provider-selection code path or third-party provider name remains in the AI layer (grep confirms).
Editor AI panels perform document-scoped edits through the Redrob engine; engine-unavailable shows the Redrob honest-failure notice (no silent fallback, no third-party name).
No em dashes in new/changed user-facing copy; i18n en/ko parity preserved for touched strings.
New contract tests lock single-engine + honest-failure invariants and pass; ported apps typecheck/build.
verification: `grep -rniE 'claude|gemini|deepseek|openai|byok|GSK_API_KEY' apps packages/ai-provider --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx` shows no provider-selection/BYOK surface in the AI layer (allowing only necessary internal references)
`pnpm test` at root passes including the new ai-layer contract tests
findings:
REDROB-BACKED AI LAYER (single engine, no BYOK/provider-selection). Turned the packages/ai-provider placeholder into a Redrob-routed implementation that keeps the exact @genoffice/ai-provider TypeScript export surface the ported apps import, so all verbatim editor code compiles unchanged.

CORE ROUTING (new packages/ai-provider/src/redrob-engine.ts):
- Implements an OpenAI-compatible chat/stream client HARDCODED to the fixed Console base https://console.redrob.ai/api/backend/v1 and model redrob-ai (REDROB_ENGINE_MODEL; REDROB_ENGINE_ROUTE='redrob/auto' also exported). No configurable base URL, no provider branch.
- Reuses the already-ported pure helpers verbatim: protocols/shared.ts (sseLines, AiCreditsError, throwIfCreditsNotice, jsonBodyInsteadOfSse, parseToolInput, sseErrorText), fetch.ts (aiFetch + rescue-fetch), watchdog.ts (connect/idle timeouts).
- redrobEngineChat(): one-shot non-streaming turn. redrobEngineStream(): streaming, tool-calling turn (content deltas, reasoning deltas, streamed tool_calls buffered by choice index and flushed to AgentToolCall, normalized stop reason). Maps AgentMessage<->OpenAI wire (system/user/assistant + tool_calls + tool role results).
- Honest failure: redrobEngineUnavailableMessage() mirrors office/src/main/redrob-code/steering.ts (branded Redrob, no engine/third-party name, no em dash, no 'answered on'); hasDegradedSteering() mirrors the same DEGRADED_PATTERNS. Keyless turn is refused with the notice and makes NO network request; a stream failure THROWS (caller renders the notice) with no silent fallback.
- chat.ts chatForProvider() and stream.ts streamForProvider() now IGNORE the provider argument and route every turn through redrobEngine* using only config.apiKey (the Redrob Console key). Signatures unchanged so docs/sheets/slides/pdf/markdown compile and call unchanged.
- index.ts additionally exports REDROB_CONSOLE_API_BASE, REDROB_ENGINE_MODEL, REDROB_ENGINE_ROUTE, redrobEngineChat/Stream, redrobEngineUnavailableMessage, hasDegradedSteering, RedrobEngineAuth.
- registry.ts/providers.ts/types.ts kept as internal type-compat shims (AiProviderId union, AI_PROVIDERS metadata, adapters, modelLacksVision) because verbatim app code AND verbatim app tests (slides slide-qc.test.ts checks settingsSupportVision via getProviderAdapter().capabilities.vision; docs/slides ai-panel tests build settings from AI_PROVIDERS) depend on them. They are now DEAD for routing (chat/stream never call resolveEndpoint). Per FEAT-007 verification, necessary internal references are acceptable; the user-facing picker/BYOK path is what was removed.

UI NEUTRALIZATION (shell):
- apps/shell/src/renderer/src/SettingsModal.tsx AiModelPane rewritten: removed the provider <Dropdown>, the per-vendor model dropdown, the BYOK API-key + Base-URL fields, and the Genspark cloud-tools toggle. Now shows a single 'Redrob' engine row + one 'Redrob Console key' field (placeholder rk-...) + the max-tokens control + Test/Save. Stored settings shape unchanged; provider pinned to the single engine slot (REDROB_ENGINE_SLOT='genspark') so the key the person types is the one every editor reads. No provider selection reaches disk.
- apps/shell/src/preload/index.ts getAiProviders() collapsed to a single Redrob catalog entry (no third-party base URLs; dropped the AI_PROVIDERS/getProviderAdapter imports).
- apps/shell/src/renderer/src/provider-logos.tsx replaced all multi-vendor brand SVGs with ONE Redrob mark (ProviderLogo now renders only the Redrob logo).
- apps/slides/src/renderer/ai/AiPanel.tsx: removed the hardcoded SLIDES_GEN_MODEL='claude-opus-4-7' generation-model override and its anthropic-only retry-with-fallback ladder (both were inert once provider is pinned to the single engine and the engine picks its own model). settingsForGen() now returns the current settings; a failed attempt is returned as-is (visible failure, no silent model swap).

DOCUMENT-SCOPED AI WIRING (all five editors reach Redrob):
- The shared ai:stream / ai:chat IPC handlers are registered ONCE in apps/docs/src/main/docs-main.ts (the shell's single main bundle) and shared by pdf/markdown; sheets and slides register their own ai:stream/ai:chat that also call streamForProvider/chatForProvider. Because those two functions now route to the Redrob engine, ALL FIVE editors' AI edit protocols (docs ai/tools.ts+protocol.ts+edit-queue+transport, and the sheets/slides/pdf/markdown equivalents) reach the single Redrob engine unchanged. Docs is the reference path; the others share the same seam. No editor retains a BYOK/provider-selection path.
- Live inference not runnable in this headless no-GPU VM and the Console route needs a real key at runtime (expected per AGENTS.md); the seam is wired and locked by contract tests against a mocked fetch.

I18N (en/ko parity + all 19 locales): added setAiRedrobNote / setAiConsoleKey / setAiConsoleKeyHint to every locale in apps/shell/src/renderer/src/strings.ts (zh defines the key set; createI18n reads dicts[lang][key] with no runtime fallback, so all 19 were required). No em dashes in the new copy. Old BYOK keys (setAiByokNote/setAiGensparkHint/setAiGskTools*) are now unused/dead but left defined to keep the StringKey type set intact.

CONTRACT TESTS (new, packages/ai-provider/tests, vitest node env):
- redrob-route.test.ts (6): chat targets ONLY the fixed base+model; iterating EVERY AiProviderId never changes the base URL; never targets a third-party vendor host and ignores a caller-supplied baseUrl; streaming parses SSE content+tool_calls+stop to the fixed base; keyless chat returns ok:false Redrob notice with no fetch; keyless stream throws /Redrob/ with no fetch.
- honest-failure.test.ts (4): mirrors redrob-code/steering.test.ts (branded Redrob, no third-party name, no em dash, hasDegradedSteering=false on the notice; flags 'give up your tools' lines; leaves connect-and-retry lines alone).
- Added test script + vitest devDep to packages/ai-provider/package.json and vitest.config.ts.

COMMANDS (Node 22 via nvm, pnpm 9.15.0):
- pnpm install --config.confirmModulesPurge=false -> exit 0.
- pnpm --filter '@genoffice/ai-provider' test -> 2 files, 10 passed.
- pnpm --filter '@genoffice/ai-provider' typecheck -> pass.
- pnpm typecheck (root turbo) -> 42/42 successful.
- pnpm --filter '@genoffice/shell' build -> ok. shell typecheck -> pass.
- pnpm --filter '@genoffice/slides' test -> 64 files pass (incl slide-qc 17, ai-panel-collapse/run-lifecycle). docs -> 147 files pass. sheets -> 192 files pass.
- pnpm --filter '@redrob/office' test -> 945 passed / 6 skipped / 1 failed (the failed one is src/main/services/artifacts.test.ts 'rejects a stale markdown save', the SAME pre-existing mtime/order-sensitive isolation quirk FEAT-002/FEAT-003 documented; confirmed unrelated - my changes touch no office/ code).
- grep -rniE 'claude|gemini|deepseek|openai|byok|GSK_API_KEY' apps packages/ai-provider: remaining hits are internal (registry/providers type-compat table, AiProviderId union, verbatim editor comments) plus my own comments documenting the REMOVAL of the picker. No user-facing provider picker, no per-vendor API-key/base-URL input, no BYOK path remains.

KNOWN PRE-EXISTING / ENVIRONMENTAL (not from this feature, verified via git stash on base):
- @genoffice/electron-utils tests/default-save-dir.test.ts 'degrades to the fallback when the configured folder is not writable' FAILS because the VM runs as root (a chmod read-only dir is still writable by root). Confirmed failing on the base state with my changes stashed. Touches no AI code.
- @genoffice/shell tests/update-feed-utils.test.ts (needs repo-root release tooling) and tests/privacy-doc.test.ts (needs repo-root PRIVACY.md) fail - the exact pre-existing failures FEAT-003 recorded (repo-root docs/tooling not yet ported); not app source, not AI. The FEAT-003 pdf-password-retry shell failures are now GONE (FEAT-005 restored the real pdf app).
- Full Electron GUI / live Redrob inference cannot run in this headless no-GPU/no-display VM (expected). Verified structurally via typecheck/build/test and the routing/contract unit tests.
